title: Ollama Engine
dual_lane_active_badge: Dual-Lane Architecture Active (P0 User / P1 24/7 Background)
parallel_slots_hint: Reserves 1 low-latency slot for user speech and dedicated slots for 24/7 background reasoning.
context_window_hint: Token memory capacity per request. Prevents silent context truncations in complex analytical processes.
max_predict_hint: Maximum allowed completion length (surpasses the legacy 500-token limit).
max_loaded_models_hint: Number of neural networks retained concurrently in RAM/VRAM to prevent slow reloading cycles.
keep_alive_hint: Duration model weights remain loaded after the last generated token.
cpu_threads_hint: Parallel compute threads for inference (recommended equal to physical cores).
flash_attention_hint: Reduces KV-cache memory footprint and speeds up long context processing.
btn_reset_auto_tooltip: Instantly recalculates and applies the optimal profile based on detected CPU, RAM, and GPU
bench_subtitle: Measures real throughput in tokens per second
save_applied: Configuration saved and Ollama systemd service reloaded successfully.
reset_success: Optimal hardware profile recalculated and applied successfully.
restart_success: Restart signal dispatched to the Ollama service.
